subject: general
question:
What is the expansion of WWW in relation to computers?

A. World Wide Web

B. Web Wide World

C. Whole World Web

D. Wide Word Web
solution:
The correct answer is **__A.__**

__
 
• The **World Wide Web **is an information system where **documents **and **other web resources** are identified by **Uniform Resource Locators.**
 
• It is **interlinked **by **hypertext **and is **accessible **over the **Internet**.
 
• **English scientist Sir Timothy Berners-Lee invented the World Wide Web in 1989.**
 
• He **wrote **the **first web browser in 1990** while employed at **CERN near Geneva, Switzerland.**
 
• The **browser **was released outside **CERN **to other research institutions starting in **January 1991**, and then to the **general public in August 1991.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

**Some important expands related to the web are:**

 
• **URL **- Uniform Resource Locator.
 
• **LAN **- Local Area Network.
 
• **WAN **- Wide Area Network.
 
• **HTTP **- Hypertext Transfer Protocol.
 
• **SMTP **- Simple Mail Transfer Protocol.
 
• **HTML **- Hypertext Markup Language.
